configuration.status: Paper explainer configuration; user-requested shared-input rerun. No sensitivity variants.
configuration.input_policy: Both explainers receive identical training-median-filled inputs; original paper code gave SHAP raw missing values.
configuration.model_provenance: Existing retrained paper-settings LightGBM from previous task; original fitted paper model unavailable. 190 rounds versus 204 in original console output.
configuration.shap: shap.TreeExplainer(model), defaults; raw/log-odds output, tree-path-dependent without background data

lime.seed_policy: Single explainer; sequential calls in sampled row order; no per-instance reseeding.

traceability.interpretation: Different checks in different units; their magnitudes must not be compared as a ratio.

representation.interpretation: Representation proxy only. SHAP labels attach the actual model input; SHAP itself returns attributions. Binary-feature bins may identify a single value. Neither method establishes causal actionability.

category_definitions.encoded_categoricals: All columns label-encoded from object/string data before splitting.
category_definitions.plain_meaning: AMT_* or CNT_* or names containing _CNT_; plus DAYS_BIRTH, DAYS_EMPLOYED, OWN_CAR_AGE.
category_definitions.other: All remaining fields, including other day offsets, regional ratings, housing aggregates, and other flags. No column is silently assigned to plain meaning.

part_b.interpretation: Prespecified name-based content proxy; not measured human comprehension. Plain meaning does not guarantee reader understanding. Categories are disjoint and exhaustive.

part_c.rule: Within each predicted class (score < 0.5 accepted; >= 0.5 rejected), select the applicant minimizing absolute distance from that class median LIME R²; ties resolved by earliest position in the original seed-42 sample. No further exclusions.
